subject: OSS maintainer free credits request — NimbusDB (self-serve escalation)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@openlib.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: OSS credits for NimbusDB (self-serve follow-up)

Hi Marissa,

I'm Samira, maintainer for NimbusDB (https://github.com/openlib/nimbusdb). We recently hit the free-tier limit for CI and integration testing for our community CI runners; several contributors are blocked on PRs. We tried the self-serve credits flow but the requested amount exceeded the automated cap and flagged for manual approval.

Request:
- One-time credit: 2,000,000 tokens equivalent (~$2,000) to cover CI, Docs CI, and community demo infra for 3 months.
- Account to credit: team@nimbus.dev (org billing account)
- Link to project & contributor list attached (community_proposal.pdf, contributor_list.csv)

We also provide confirmation that Nimbus is an Apache-2 project and does not process customer PII. Happy to share any repo telemetry you need.

Thanks for considering — several maintainers are waiting on merges.

Best,
Samira Khan
Lead Maintainer, NimbusDB
samira@openlib.dev
https://openlib.dev
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: OSS credits for NimbusDB (self-serve follow-up)

Marissa,

Samira pinged from NimbusDB — asks for 2M tokens / $2k for 3 months. Attachments show active contributor list and Apache-2 license. A few quick Qs before we approve:
- Confirm intended promo type: one-time credit vs monthly stipend?
- Will org billing account team@nimbus.dev be the one redeeming (they have not used Redwood in the past)?
- Any E2E restrictions we should apply (IP ranges, rate limits)?

If you approve, Tessa can issue a promo code and we can set it to expire in 90 days. Recommend marking as OSS community grant (no SLA).

Thanks,
Aditya
Growth Ops
From: Samira Khan <samira@openlib.dev>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: OSS credits for NimbusDB (self-serve follow-up)

Thanks Aditya — answers below:
- One-time credit that covers usage up to 2M tokens over 90 days.
- team@nimbus.dev will redeem and is the org billing admin. I can create the account now if you need a support request id.
- No special IP restrictions needed. We do ask that credits be restricted to text-generation and embeddings endpoints to prevent accidental compute-intensive jobs; rate limits are OK.

Attaching contributor list and proposal.

Appreciate the fast help — CI is backlogged.

Samira
